compendium.summary: Finite duplicate, second action set and separate concentration.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Component planning: High-level action-economy tech. Needs money, time, and DM rules.
Pre-cast gate: Secure the casting window, component, template state, finite resource budget, and repair plan.
Failure state: The copy wastes nonrenewable resources, is destroyed, or relies on prohibited recursion.
Safe operating default: Assign a role and slot budget. The copy never creates another Simulacrum.
